title: Native and cross-platform receipts predate the audited implementation
claim: The audited head has no exact-head native or three-platform evidence after material changes to the Phase 18 execution, adapter, bundle, verifier, trajectory, and report surfaces; therefore the registered real-Agent, native-benchmark, seam-matrix, and platform exit obligations are not currently demonstrated.

evidence.detail: The terminal native evidence is artifact 9720758617 from run 33271354427 at candidate 27344e3, while the audited head is dd7eda70aa138ea02931068b5f69ceb31148682b.
The terminal three-platform receipt binds candidate_head 0f5a3fa152b12d7be4036b2a08ae7a195f8c2107 and run 33305179715, not the audited head.

evidence.location: git diff 27344e3..dd7eda70aa138ea02931068b5f69ceb31148682b -- Phase 18 implementation and test surfaces
evidence.detail: The native candidate is an ancestor, but 62 scoped files changed afterward (5,885 insertions, 742 deletions), including 19 production files under crates/opi-eval/src and changes to agent, process, bundle, benchmark, integrity, trajectory, runner, regrade, report, native-verifier, and workflow paths.

Current local tests pass, but multiple real integration/report/native-driver suites are cfg(unix) and ran zero tests on Windows; verifier regression tests validate stored receipts and fixtures rather than executing current Opi/pi binaries in the official task packages and native graders.
